geometryBasis: The native 78-vertex palace way fixes the main residence, two attached forecourt wings and the open horseshoe. The central entrance node and five marked wing entries are retained as controls.
sectionBasis: Two cleared Qualla garden views and three cleared Rakoon courtyard and wing views establish the 2023 palace character. The university documents three storeys and four courtyard and three garden steps. Fine balustrades, ornament, roof depth and facade heights are estimated.
